  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

    ↑((SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map.toImage
              (IntegrationInACVF.Section7.gammaRVGraphRefinementMap A F.parameters hNames)).toFun
          a) ∈
      P.matchingPart),
  (↑(F.vertical.projection a)).2 F.vertical.paradigm_index ≠ SpecialTransformations.Section5.rv 0 →
    have p :=
      ⟨↑((SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map.toImage
                (IntegrationInACVF.Section7.gammaRVGraphRefinementMap A F.parameters hNames)).toFun
            a),
        hMatch⟩;

      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map.toImage
            (IntegrationInACVF.Section7.gammaRVGraphRefinementMap P.matchingNative P.matchingKeyLabels hNames)).toFun
        p;

      {x |

          (↑(F.vertical.projection a)).2 F.vertical.paradigm_index ≠ SpecialTransformations.Section5.rv 0)
      (hfin :
        ∀ (x : Fin 2 → SpecialTransformations.Section5.VF),
          {r | (x, r) ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A}.Finite)
      (δ : Fin (m + F.arity + (1 + P.inFixedContext.sourceArity + (1 + P.inFixedContext.targetArity))))
      (hδ :
        ∀ (p : ↑P.inFixedContext.matchingPreparedFamily.carrier),
          ↑((↑p).2 δ) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero),
      let Q := P.inFixedContext;
      ∃ LV LH,
        have PV := Q.matchingVerticalPullbackPreparation hNonzero LV;
        have PH := Q.matchingHorizontalPullbackPreparation hNonzero LH;
        have hsmall := ⋯;
        have hfinH := ⋯;
        have hδH := hδ;
        have hAF := ⋯;
        have hBF := ⋯;
        have hδV := ⋯;
        have hδW := ⋯;
        ∃ e, e.GammaDefinable G

@IntegrationInACVF.Section7.graded_positive_scalar_balance : ∀ {A : ℕ → Type} [inst : (i : ℕ) → AddCommMonoid (A i)]
  [inst_1 : DirectSum.GSemiring A] {S : Type} [inst_2 : Ring S] {P N : Type} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid P]
  [inst_4 : Module (DirectSum ℕ A) P] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_6 : Module S N] (φ : DirectSum ℕ A →+* S)
  (I : P →+ N) (a : A 1),
  φ ((DirectSum.of A 1) a) = 1 →
    (∀ (i : ℕ) (u : A (i + 1)) (f : P), I ((DirectSum.of A (i + 1)) u • f) = φ ((DirectSum.of A (i + 1)) u) • I f) →
      ∀ (r : DirectSum ℕ A) (f : P), I (r • f) = φ r • I f
